items.docs:
This endpoint returns insights about the authenticated seller's shop, including product counts, shop rating, offers awaiting review, boost ad counts and orders awaiting shipping.

**Required OAuth Scopes:** at least one of the scopes below. Each section of the response is included only when its corresponding scope is present, and omitted otherwise. A `403` is returned only when none of these scopes are present.
- `products_read` - Include product counts (`products`) and boost ad counts (`boost`)

params.name: sku
params.description: SKU of the product to fetch insights for.

items.docs:
This endpoint returns live insights about a single product in the authenticated seller's shop, identified by its SKU, including likes, bag adds, offers awaiting review and boosted-listing performance.

**Required OAuth Scopes:** at least one of the scopes below. Each section of the response is included only when its corresponding scope is present, and omitted otherwise. A `403` is returned only when none of these scopes are present.
- `products_read` - Include likes (`likes_count`) and bag adds
